scope: Current V2 limitations and decisions. Retired Pre-Alpha assessment and numerical experiments live in Git history, not the runtime distribution.

findings.disposition: Hidden Game rendering and editing-preview LOD were corrected. Current whole-frame SDK editor/standalone observations are recorded in docs/WHOLE_ENGINE_PERFORMANCE.md; different viewport sizes and workloads do not establish universal editor/runtime parity.
Humanoid get-up and animation blending remain limited; no claim of general natural physical recovery.

Native Linux integrated development and Ubuntu/Windows build/contracts passed at the recorded V2 baseline. Current Windows desktop graphics/export, Android and browser runtime remain unqualified; historical device acceptance is not inherited.

Portable rendering and CPU particle simulation/collision remain legitimate capability fallbacks, not historical compatibility. The whole-engine audit qualifies a real 5,000-particle CPU fallback separately from unsupported required-GPU authoring.
Content-dependent dense contact and CCD safety limits remain; removal of MK1 diagnostics does not change MK2 algorithms.

Prior one-slot particle first-capture and hidden-window terrain readback failures did not recur in isolated repeats. The terrain comparison now owns an image target; no universal driver/particle repeatability repair is claimed. Retain live assertions and investigate a new reproduction.
The current mod format does not admit native Terrain V2 assets; ordinary cooked mesh/scene mods and base-game terrain remain. Retired M75 fork/cook workflows are not retained.

Whole-engine audit improved ordinary gameplay without changing accepted physical outcomes. Severe CCD impacts, IK tails and queue-inclusive completion still miss defined 120/60 FPS or 5 ms goals; see docs/WHOLE_ENGINE_PERFORMANCE.md. Functional or relative p99 passes are not universal performance qualification.

Large active private model/image sets can exceed resource cache targets because live pinned data cannot be evicted. This is content-dependent footprint, not evidence of unbounded growth; private assets remain outside Git/SDKs.

CMake still declares judas_script_presentation_tests, whose source copies removed projects/shooter_game and projects/boundary_demo and missing docs/evidence/m52 originals. It is absent from the supported validation manifest. Documentation cleanup does not repair or certify this target; reconcile or retire it as a separate implementation task.
